generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
In the Sanctioned Estimate, the item rates are showing inclusive of all applicable taxes but it is to be noted that rates are exclusive of taxes (GST)

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 continued to 2026-27 and prevailing GST (18% of Amount Put to tender) amount is kept in the form of Lump sum in sanctioned estimate according to guidelines in Common SR 2023-24 (As per the circular from Govt of Karnataka no.12/2024 Bengaluru dt:09.08.2024). Therefore, Amount put to Tender and ECV amounts are excluding GST even though it is showing inclusive Tax in Draft Tender Schedule Process. Hence, GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly. The bidder has to quote the rate exclusive of GST and to submit a declaration which is duly signed by the bidder along with their tender proposal.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
The contractor shall submit the details of technical staff employed by him.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of KPP-Portal on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments shall be made through e-payment mode only and same shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public procurement (KPP) portal.
Royalty on construction materials and other applicable taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incidents happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

The item rates quoted shall include cost of royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per the rates provided in prevailing cost & conveyance of all materials, Curing, Watering, unloading with all leads & lifts, labor, hire charges of machinery equipment etc., complete including all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work.
Further particulars, if any queries required to the Contractor, they can get from the office of the concerned Executive Engineer, PWD Division, during office hours on all working days.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.
The Tenderer should furnish all necessary original documents mentioned in the bid document to the Executive engineer at the time of verification of documents during Technical Bid evaluation.
The intending bidders are requested to note that they should abide by the instructions and conditions contained in the bid documents and further orders thereon.
Contractor has to upload the valid EPF registration copy.

The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor has to submit MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars.
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD.300.LET.2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW.134.BMS.2007 dated 27.07.2007 a sum amounting to 1 Percent of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified on his own risk and cost.

Materials like bitumen, steel and cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the Quality Assurance Authority before commencement of the work.
Work shall be carried out according to relevant IS/IRC codes specifications depending on type of work.
The bidder has to establish field laboratory at the work site as per GO No:PWD/243/SEV/2013 Bengaluru dated:22.07.2014.
The Defect Liability period for this work is one year

The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor has to submit MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars

itemList.description:
Mechanical Means -
Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means  for all   works   & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including setting out,     shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,     including  dressing  of excavated  surfaces,  disposing  off  or  levelling  the  excavated  earth  or  sorting &   stacking the selected   earth for reuse in a radius of   50 m and lift upto 1.5 m  including  cost  of  labour,  tools,  usage  of  machinery  &  other  appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 3 m ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete  for  levelling  course  for all  works  in  foundation.  The    granite/trap/basalt    crushed  graded  coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  and all the other  appurtenances  required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: PIPE CULVERTS - Providing and Laying Reinforced Cement Concrete Pipe NP3 as per design in Single Row - Providing and laying reinforced cement concrete pipe NP3 for  culverts  on  first  class  bedding  of  granular   material  in single row including   fixing collar with cement mortar 1:2 but   excluding   excavation,   protection   works,   backfilling, concrete  and  masonry  works  in  head  walls  and  parapets Clause 1101.6. - 1000mm dia. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1101.6 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

Providing  and  laying  in  Cement  Concrete    for  all  Basement  &  surface  level works,  return  walls,  retaining  walls,  sunken  floors  etc.  The    granite/trap/ basalt  crushed graded coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle  vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all   other   appurtenances    required to complete the work as per technical  specifications. - M 20   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -14- RIVER TRAINING AND PROTECTION WORKS
itemList.description: Providing  and  laying  Pitching  on  slopes  laid  over  prepared filter  media  including  boulder  apron  laid  dry  in  front  of  toe of    embankment    complete    as    per    drawing    and    Technical specifications - Stone/Boulder. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 2504 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Granular Sub-Base - By Mix in Place Method - Construction  of  Granular  Sub-Base  of  required  grading  as  per design     spreading   in   uniform   layers   with   motor   grader   on prepared surface mixing by mix in place method with front end loader at OMC and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired density, complete as per clause 401 - For Grading -V Material. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 401 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Deep Potholes using WBM Gr l & SDBC Gr lI 25 mm thick: Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base  course  using  material  confirming  to  WBM  Grade  -I  with 1ype  Sereenings  standards  wherever  necessary  by  manual means  including  trimming  the  pothole  to  the  required  shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Road Delineators - Supplying and installation of delineators (road way indicators, hazard markers, object markers), 80-100 cm high above ground level, painted black and white in 15 cm wide strips, fitted with 80 x 100 mm rectangular or 75 mm dia circular reflectorised panels  at  the  top,  buried  or  pressed  into  the  ground  and conforming to IRC-79-2019 and the drawings. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 806 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.
